# Mili 1.1.7 — updates download once

## What changed

- **One download per update.** The updater used to try to patch the new installer against the one it had downloaded before, then fall back to a full download when that copy was gone — which is the normal case right after installing. That first attempt transferred the whole file for nothing, so every update pulled roughly twice the data and the progress bar ran to 100%, dropped back to 1% and started over. Mili now only asks for the patch-based download when the old installer is actually cached, and downloads the file once.
- **Release notes live in the repository** (`.github/release-notes/<version>.md`), so the workflow writes this page itself from the commit that produced the build instead of notes being pasted in by hand after the fact.

## Download

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Mili-Setup-1.1.7.exe** | Installer. Installs for your user, no admin rights, and keeps itself up to date. |
| **Mili-1.1.7-portable.exe** | Single file. Run it from anywhere, nothing is installed — updates are a manual download. |
| **latest.yml** + **Mili-Setup-1.1.7.exe.blockmap** | Update metadata that installed copies read. Leave them attached to the release. |

Requires Windows 10/11 and, for music, the Spotify desktop app.
